title: JointLight: Human-Centric Video Relighting with Asynchronous RGB-Irradiance Joint Modeling
title_zh: JointLight：基于异步RGB-辐照度联合建模的以人为中心的视频重光照

paragraphs.en: Understanding and modeling light transport in human-centric scenes is a longstanding challenge. While recent progress in diffusion models has boosted research in relighting, precise illumination control still lags, primarily due to the scarcity of diverse, high-quality, precisely labeled video relighting datasets. Existing end-to-end relighting approaches model light transport implicitly through neural networks, which substantially complicates controllability. In contrast, some works resort to path-traced irradiance cues as an explicit blueprint for light transport. However, such constructed irradiance cues are prone to artifacts and hinder generative quality when directly used as control signals. With the key observation that noise corruption removes high-frequency artifacts and preserves low-frequency light transport, we introduce an asynchronous joint-modeling paradigm that facilitates fine-grained illumination control. During two-stage training, we force the model to jointly denoise RGB and ground-truth irradiance frames with separate timesteps scheduling. A domain matching strategy is applied to the second stage to bridge the domain gap between irradiance cues and ground-truth irradiance maps. At inference time, we introduce an asynchronous hijacked generation pipeline that facilitates flexible illumination control. For training data, we develop a multi-illumination high-quality synthetic video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model exhibits robust generalization to real-world scenarios and outperforms prior approaches in both lighting fidelity and generative quality. Project page: http://www.geometrylearning.com/JointLight/
paragraphs.zh: 理解并建模以人为中心的场景中的光传输是一项长期存在的挑战。 尽管扩散模型的最新进展推动了重光照研究的发展，但精确的光照控制仍然滞后，这主要是由于缺乏多样化、高质量且标注精确的视频重光照数据集。 现有的端到端重光照方法通过神经网络隐式地建模光传输，这极大地增加了可控性的难度。 相比之下，一些工作采用路径追踪的辐照度线索作为光传输的显式蓝图。 然而，此类构造的辐照度线索容易产生伪影，且在直接用作控制信号时会损害生成质量。 基于噪声破坏能够去除高频伪影并保留低频光传输这一关键观察，我们提出了一种异步联合建模范式，以实现细粒度的光照控制。 在两阶段训练过程中，我们通过独立的时间步调度，强制模型对 RGB 和真值辐照度帧进行联合去噪。 在第二阶段应用了一种域匹配策略，以弥合辐照度线索与真值辐照度图之间的域差距。 在推理阶段，我们引入了一种异步劫持生成管线，以实现灵活的光照控制。 在训练数据方面，我们利用强大的游戏引擎开发了一个带配对辐照度图的多光照高质量合成视频数据集。 仅在该数据集上训练，我们的模型就对真实世界场景展现出鲁棒的泛化能力，并在光照保真度和生成质量两方面均优于先前的方法。 项目主页：http://www.geometrylearning.com/JointLight/

paragraphs.en: Lighting fundamentally affects how we perceive a scene. Modifying lighting while preserving scene identity enables a wide range of applications, such as artistic creation, film production, augmented reality, and computer vision research. Fundamentally, relighting requires an understanding of how light interacts with the scene. Traditional graphics pipelines simulate physical light transport with explicit geometry and materials. For objects and portraits, meticulously calibrated studio equipment ( Debevec, 2012 ) is used to reconstruct geometry and capture reflectance fields. However, real-world scenes comprise complex combinations of objects and persons, of which the geometry and material properties are impractical to capture. Relighting of human-centric scenes in diverse indoor and outdoor environments thus remains a challenging task.
paragraphs.zh: 光照从根本上影响着我们对场景的感知。 在保持场景身份的前提下修改光照，能够支持广泛的应用，例如艺术创作、电影制作、增强现实和计算机视觉研究。 从根本上说，重光照需要对光如何与场景交互有所理解。 传统图形流水线通过显式的几何与材质来模拟物理光传输。 对于物体和人像，可以使用经过精心校准的摄影棚设备（Debevec, 2012）来重建几何并采集反射场。 然而，现实世界中的场景由物体与人物的复杂组合构成，其几何与材质属性难以实际采集。 因此，在多样化的室内外环境中对以人为中心的场景进行重光照仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。

paragraphs.en: With the advent of powerful generative models, relighting with a single image or video input has drawn increasing attention. It is an innately ill-posed problem, since geometry, material, and lighting are all coupled in the single input. Some works ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ) construct degradation pairs for real-world images or videos and train end-to-end diffusion models for relighting. These methods, lacking explicit physical light transport modeling, are typically constrained to text prompts or environment maps as conditioning inputs, failing to offer precise control over lighting parameters such as light source angles. Some other works ( Liang et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) utilize graphics engines to construct synthetic data, enabling relighting with environment maps as a condition. Such synthetic data are limited to simple object-centric scenes, hindering generalization to complex human-centric real-world scenarios. More importantly, implicit light transport modeling within neural networks cannot guarantee physical accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 随着强大生成模型的出现，基于单张图像或单个视频输入的重打光（relighting）受到越来越多的关注。 这本质上是一个病态问题，因为几何、材质与光照在单一输入中相互耦合。 一些工作（Zhang et al., 2025b；Fang et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025c）为真实世界的图像或视频构建退化对，并训练端到端扩散模型来进行重打光。 这些方法缺乏显式的光传输建模，通常只能以文本提示或环境贴图作为条件输入，无法对光源角度等光照参数提供精确控制。 另一些工作（Liang et al., 2025；He et al., 2025）利用图形引擎构建合成数据，实现了以环境贴图为条件的重打光。 这类合成数据仅限于简单的以物体为中心的场景，难以泛化到复杂的以人为中心的真实世界场景。 更重要的是，神经网络内部的隐式光传输建模无法保证物理上的准确性。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in monocular geometry estimation ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Wang et al., 2025f ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Mescheder et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) have opened new avenues for scene relighting. While monocular point clouds serve as a coarse geometric proxy, they are unsuitable for direct integration into traditional graphics pipelines due to single-layer geometry and artifacts from depth discontinuities at object boundaries. With a diffuse white BRDF and physics-based rendering, this proxy produces an irradiance cue that characterizes the scene’s diffuse light transport, as illustrated in Figure 3 . Although this irradiance cue remains plagued by artifacts and exhibits a significant domain gap relative to the ground-truth irradiance map, we propose that this discrepancy can be effectively bridged through noise corruption. The key observation is that after blending with a certain amount of Gaussian noise, the rough irradiance cue and ground-truth irradiance map become indistinguishable. In this way, noise corruption mitigates the domain gap by removing high-frequency artifacts and preserving low-frequency content. We then model this rough irradiance distribution via the diffusion process. During training, the model jointly denoises RGB video and irradiance maps with separate timestep scheduling, learning to transform a noised irradiance cue into a pixel-aligned fine-grained irradiance map. At inference time, we render the irradiance cue using a geometry estimate and the target lighting with a path tracer. The irradiance cue is then noised and jointly denoised with the RGB video.
paragraphs.zh: 单目几何估计的最新进展（Wang et al., 2025e；Wang et al., 2025f；Lin et al., 2025；Mescheder et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025a）为场景重光照开辟了新途径。 虽然单目点云可以作为粗糙的几何代理，但由于其单层几何结构以及物体边界处深度不连续产生的伪影，它并不适合直接集成到传统图形管线中。 利用漫反射白色 BRDF 和基于物理的渲染，该代理可生成一个表征场景漫反射光传输的辐照度线索，如图 3 所示。 尽管这一辐照度线索仍然受到伪影困扰，并且相对于真实辐照度图存在显著的域差距，我们提出可以通过噪声破坏来有效弥合这一差距。 关键的观察是，在与一定量的高斯噪声混合后，粗糙的辐照度线索与真实辐照度图变得难以区分。 通过这种方式，噪声破坏通过去除高频伪影并保留低频内容来缓解域差距。 然后，我们通过扩散过程对这种粗糙的辐照度分布进行建模。 在训练期间，模型以各自的时间步调度联合去噪 RGB 视频和辐照度图，学习将含噪的辐照度线索转换为像素对齐的细粒度辐照度图。 在推理时，我们使用几何估计结果和目标光照通过路径追踪器渲染辐照度线索。 随后对辐照度线索加噪，并与 RGB 视频一起进行联合去噪。

paragraphs.en: For training data, we develop a large-scale human-centric multi-illumination video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. It contains 68K synthetic videos from 6.8K dynamic scenes across 30 artist-made 3D environments. A character performing random actions is placed in the center of the camera, where random camera shake and camera movement are applied. Each scene is rendered with 10 different lighting conditions sampled from 821 HDR environment maps, of which 20% are set to rotating.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练数据方面，我们使用强大的游戏引擎构建了一个大规模的以人为中心、带成对辐照度图的多光照视频数据集。 该数据集包含来自30个美术师制作的3D环境中6.8K个动态场景的68K个合成视频。 一个执行随机动作的角色被放置在摄像机中心，并施加随机的摄像机抖动和摄像机移动。 每个场景在从821张HDR环境贴图中采样的10种不同光照条件下进行渲染，其中20%设置为旋转光照。

paragraphs.en: A high-quality human-centric multi-illumination video dataset with paired irradiance maps across diverse indoor and outdoor lighting conditions. This dataset will be publicly released to advance research in human-centric video relighting and intrinsic decomposition.

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on video relighting in both visual quality and lighting fidelity.

paragraphs.en: While object-centric ( Jin et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2024b ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Bharadwaj et al., 2025 ; Mao et al., 2025 ) and portrait-centric ( Lv et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Saito et al., 2024 ; Chaturvedi et al., 2025 ; Mei et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) static relighting have been extensively explored, human-centric video relighting in dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes remains underexplored. Many works ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) rely on degradation pairs with text prompts or environment maps, but provide only coarse control and often produce stylized results. ( Liang et al., 2026 ) use path tracing rendering as an anchor point to online optimize static relighting results, which cannot extend to dynamic scenes. DiffusionRenderer ( Liang et al., 2025 ) curates synthetic multi-illumination data with simple objects and paired G-buffers, training separate inverse and forward rendering models. UniRelight ( He et al., 2025 ) further extends this to end-to-end video relighting. However, both methods input environment maps directly without explicit light transport guidance, limiting generalization in complex scenes with occlusions. In contrast, our method targets general dynamic scenes beyond portraits and employs physically-based irradiance cues to achieve more accurate lighting control.

paragraphs.en: Several related systems target narrower capture settings or different control interfaces. SwitchLight ( Kim et al., 2024 ) decomposes a single portrait using a physics-guided architecture and relights it from an environment map, whereas DifFRelight ( He et al., 2024 ) learns subject-specific facial-performance relighting from light-stage data. Relightable Full-Body Gaussian Codec Avatars ( Wang et al., 2025d ) models local and non-local light transport for captured, personalized avatars. ReLumix ( Wang et al., 2025b ) propagates the illumination of one artist-relit reference frame through a video rather than taking a target environment map directly. The commercial Runway Relight Scene system ( Runway, 2026 ) instead uses text descriptions to edit the atmosphere of short videos. These methods demonstrate complementary progress, but do not address pixel-aligned, environment-map-controlled relighting of general monocular human-centric videos in the wild.
paragraphs.zh: 若干相关系统针对更窄的采集场景或不同的控制接口。 SwitchLight（Kim et al., 2024）使用物理引导的架构对单张人像进行分解，并根据环境贴图对其进行重光照，而 DifFRelight（He et al., 2024）则从光场采集数据中学习特定主体的面部表演重光照。 Relightable Full-Body Gaussian Codec Avatars（Wang et al., 2025d）为采集得到的个性化智能体化身建模局部与非局部光传输。 ReLumix（Wang et al., 2025b）将某一帧经艺术家重光照的参考帧的光照传播到整段视频中，而非直接接受目标环境贴图。 商用的 Runway Relight Scene 系统（Runway, 2026）则使用文本描述来编辑短视频的氛围。 这些方法展示了互补性的进展，但均未解决对真实场景下通用单目以人为中心的视频进行像素对齐、环境贴图控制的重光照问题。

paragraphs.en: RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X ( Zeng et al., 2024a ) shows pixel-aligned irradiance maps can serve as lighting control signals, but require an existing clean irradiance map as input. DiLightNet ( Zeng et al., 2024b ) , PractiLight ( Erel et al., 2025 ) , and Lightit ( Kocsis et al., 2024 ) compute irradiance cues from target lighting and coarse depth, but misalignment with the input image due to noisy geometry undermines relighting quality. Portrait-specific relighting methods such as Total Relighting ( Pandey et al., 2021 ) focus on human faces and use image-based lighting without path-traced shadows, which is suitable for portrait photography but less applicable to general scenes.
paragraphs.zh: RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X（Zeng et al., 2024a）表明像素对齐的辐照度图可以作为光照控制信号，但需要一张已有的干净辐照度图作为输入。 DiLightNet（Zeng et al., 2024b）、PractiLight（Erel et al., 2025）和 Lightit（Kocsis et al., 2024）从目标光照和粗糙深度计算辐照度线索，但由于噪声几何导致与输入图像不对齐，削弱了重光照质量。 诸如 Total Relighting（Pandey et al., 2021）这样的人像专用重光照方法专注于人脸，并使用不含路径追踪阴影的基于图像的光照，这适用于人像摄影，但对一般场景的适用性较低。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have been applied to jointly model pixel-aligned attributes such as depth ( Li et al., 2025 ; Byung-Ki et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , motion ( Chefer et al., 2025 ) , and PBR attributes ( Xi et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2025 ) . Joint modeling approaches include dual-stream cross-attention ( Li et al., 2025 ; Byung-Ki et al., 2025 ) and various single-model injection paradigms ( Chefer et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025a ; Xi et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . Most such methods assume clean auxiliary modalities; in contrast, we must handle imperfect irradiance cues with substantial geometry artifacts—a domain-gap issue largely unexplored in prior work. The use of per-modality asynchronous timestep schedules has been explored in UniDiffuser ( Bao et al., 2023 ) , AVDiT ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , and Uni-Renderer ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , but none addresses imperfect auxiliary modalities at inference time. Our key contribution is applying this idea to the RGB-irradiance pairing, combined with domain matching and hijacked inference to handle noisy real-world irradiance cues.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型已被用于联合建模多种像素对齐属性，例如深度（Li et al., 2025；Byung-Ki et al., 2025；Xi et al., 2025a；Chen et al., 2025a）、运动（Chefer et al., 2025）以及 PBR 属性（Xi et al., 2025b；He et al., 2025）。 联合建模的方法包括双流交叉注意力（Li et al., 2025；Byung-Ki et al., 2025）以及各种单模型注入范式（Chefer et al., 2025；Xi et al., 2025a；Xi et al., 2025b；He et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025a）。 大多数此类方法都假设辅助模态是干净的；相比之下，我们必须处理带有显著几何伪影的不完美辐照度线索——这一领域差距问题在以往工作中基本未被探索。 每模态异步时间步调度的使用已在 UniDiffuser（Bao et al., 2023）、AVDiT（Wang et al., 2024a）和 Uni-Renderer（Chen et al., 2025b）中被探索过，但均未在推理时处理不完美的辅助模态。 我们的关键贡献是将这一思想应用于 RGB-辐照度配对，并结合域匹配与劫持式推理来处理带噪声的真实世界辐照度线索。

paragraphs.en: We build an automated UE5 pipeline for multi-illumination videos. Our assets include 30 3D environments, 60 characters, 600 body animations, 20 facial expressions, and 821 HDR environment maps. Figure 4 overviews the dataset. For each scene, a character is randomly placed and animated, while the camera is assigned random distance, rotation, and oscillation. Ray intersection tests prevent interpenetration. We use UE5’s real-time global illumination system Lumen ( Tan, 2024 ) for efficient low-frequency approximation, and add a directional light to match the brightest region of the environment map. LightingOnly mode renders the irradiance map synchronously. Each scene is rendered under 10 illuminations, with 20% using rotary lighting. In total, we render 68K videos at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution, 94 frames each, with paired irradiance maps. Lighting parameters are recorded, and prompts are generated using a video understanding model ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Among the 30 scene environments, 12 are indoor scenes and 18 are outdoor scenes. The 821 HDR environment maps are collected from public resources such as Poly Haven, covering diverse illumination conditions including outdoor daytime, indoor, and outdoor nighttime settings. We pair the MetaHuman characters with Mixamo animations and mainly keep in-place motions such as talking, dancing, and fighting, while filtering out large-displacement motions such as walking and running to better match our camera setup.

paragraphs.en: The set contains 31 male-presenting and 29 female-presenting characters; 22 dark-, 12 medium-, and 26 light-skinned characters; and 4 child, 43 adult, and 13 older characters. Our dataset focuses on human-centric indoor and outdoor scenarios, enabling precise lighting control over human subjects. Despite being trained purely on synthetic data, our model generalizes well to real-world videos. We attribute this to the high photorealism of UE5-rendered content, which substantially reduces the sim-to-real gap compared to prior Blender-based synthetic datasets. This aligns with observations from prior works trained exclusively on UE-rendered videos, such as ReCamMaster ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and Context-as-Memory ( Yu et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: We first describe how to construct the irradiance cue 𝐄 cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}} for an input video 𝐕 I \mathbf{V}^{I} , then present our asynchronous RGB-irradiance joint modeling and hijacked inference strategy for generating the relit video 𝐕 \mathbf{V} and refined irradiance map 𝐄 ^ cue \hat{\mathbf{E}}^{\text{cue}} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先描述如何为输入视频 𝐕 I \mathbf{V}^{I} 构建辐照度线索 𝐄 cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}} ，然后介绍我们的异步 RGB-辐照度联合建模与被劫持推理策略，用于生成重光照视频 𝐆 \mathbf{V} 与精细化辐照度图 𝐄 ^ cue \hat{\mathbf{E}}^{\text{cue}} 。

paragraphs.en: An irradiance cue describes diffuse light transport obtained by rendering scene geometry with target lighting. Previous works ( Zeng et al., 2024b ; Erel et al., 2025 ) use monocular depth ( Bhat et al., 2023 ) and unproject it to a mesh. We instead use monocular point-cloud estimation ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Wang et al., 2025f ) to obtain metric-level geometry and smoother meshes. We convert each estimated point cloud into a per-frame mesh and remove triangles spanning depth discontinuities with a fixed threshold-based mask. We assign a spatially uniform white diffuse BRDF , illuminate the mesh with the target environment map, and render it using Mitsuba 3 ( Jakob et al., 2022 ) . Repeating this process independently for every frame yields the irradiance cue 𝐄 cue ∈ ℝ F × H × W × 3 \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}\in\mathbb{R}^{F\times H\times W\times 3} for an input video 𝐕 \mathbf{V} . Per-frame estimation avoids accumulating global reconstruction drift, but geometry errors, removed boundary triangles, and temporal inconsistency still create a substantial gap from the ground-truth irradiance 𝐄 \mathbf{E} (Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 辐照度线索描述的是用目标光照渲染场景几何后得到的漫反射光传输。 已有工作（Zeng et al., 2024b；Erel et al., 2025）使用单目深度（Bhat et al., 2023）并将其反投影为网格。 我们改用单目点云估计（Wang et al., 2025e；Wang et al., 2025f）来获得度量级几何和更平滑的网格。 我们将每个估计的点云转换为逐帧网格，并使用基于固定阈值的掩码去除跨越深度不连续处的三角形。 我们为其赋予空间均匀的白色漫反射 BRDF，用目标环境贴图对该网格进行照明，并使用 Mitsuba 3（Jakob et al., 2022）进行渲染。 对每一帧独立地重复这一过程，即可得到输入视频 𝐕 \mathbf{V} 的辐照度线索 𝐄 cue ∈ ℝ F × H × W × 3 \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}\in\mathbb{R}^{F\times H\times W\times 3}。 逐帧估计避免了全局重建漂移的累积，但几何误差、被去除的边界三角形以及时间上的不一致性，仍会使其与真实辐照度 𝐄 \mathbf{E} 之间存在较大差距（图 3）。

paragraphs.en: Given an input video 𝐕 I \mathbf{V}^{I} and a text prompt p p , we train a model v Θ v_{\Theta} that jointly denoises the relit RGB video 𝐕 \mathbf{V} and irradiance map 𝐄 \mathbf{E} using separate timesteps t V t_{V} and t E t_{E} . This allows the model to learn denoising under mismatched noise levels and enables inference with noisy irradiance conditions (Section 5.3 ). As illustrated in Figure 2 , we concatenate the latents of noisy RGB video 𝐳 t V V \mathbf{z}_{t_{V}}^{V} , noisy irradiance map 𝐳 t E E \mathbf{z}_{t_{E}}^{E} and input video 𝐳 0 I \mathbf{z}_{0}^{I} along the frame dimension and feed into the transformer. This simple strategy allows the 3D spatial-temporal self-attention to cover input, irradiance and relit frames, enabling cross-modal understanding. While asynchronous timestep scheduling has been explored in prior multi-modal diffusion work ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , our contribution lies in applying it to the RGB-irradiance pairing, where the auxiliary modality is imperfect at inference time. This motivates our domain matching strategy and hijacked inference pipeline, which are essential for bridging the gap to noisy real-world irradiance cues.

sents.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , we concatenate the latents of noisy RGB video 𝐳 t V V \mathbf{z}_{t_{V}}^{V} , noisy irradiance map 𝐳 t E E \mathbf{z}_{t_{E}}^{E} and input video 𝐳 0 I \mathbf{z}_{0}^{I} along the frame dimension and feed into the transformer.

paragraphs.en: Since the three input modalities share pixel alignment, we apply the same RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) to assign shared spatial-temporal positions. To distinguish modalities, we introduce a learnable modality embedding on top of the timestep embedding, whose gate modulation already conditions features on timestep. Unlike prior designs that inject modality embeddings into latent features, this better avoids modality mixture in our setting.

paragraphs.en: Since the model only observes the ground-truth irradiance map 𝐄 \mathbf{E} during standard training, conditioning on imperfect irradiance cues at inference introduces a domain gap. We address this with a domain matching paradigm: at random training iterations, we replace the noisy irradiance map 𝐳 t E \mathbf{z}_{t}^{E} with the noisy cue 𝐳 t E cue \mathbf{z}_{t}^{E^{\text{cue}}} . This encourages denoising towards a probability path closer to the high-quality manifold and improves both RGB and irradiance generation. This design is fundamentally different from previous joint cross-modal modeling methods, which usually assume clean and reliable modalities during both training and inference. In contrast, our framework is explicitly designed for imperfect irradiance cues with domain discrepancies, which are common in practical relighting settings. It also differs from prior irradiance-conditioned methods that directly feed the estimated cue into the generator, making them more vulnerable to accumulated geometry and rendering errors.

paragraphs.en: In Section 5.1 we show how to construct the irradiance cue 𝐄 cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}} , given an input video and a target lighting condition. In order to utilize it during inference, we design a hijacked conditional inference strategy that guides the sampling process towards the probability path indicated by the irradiance cue. We illustrate this process in Figure 3 . Specifically, we obtain the noisy irradiance cue 𝐄 t h cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}_{t_{h}} with Eq. 4 , where t h t_{h} is the hijack timestep. Before t h t_{h} , at each timestep only the noisy RGB latents are updated while the irradiance latents remain fixed at 𝐄 t h cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}_{t_{h}} . After t h t_{h} , the two modalities are denoised together. This strategy effectively utilizes low-frequency lighting prior provided by the noisy irradiance map, while removing high-frequency artifacts by joint denoising. The hyperparameter t h t_{h} controls the amount of noise that is added to the irradiance cue, offering a flexible tradeoff between generation quality and lighting fidelity. In practice, we find that t h = 0.6 ​ T t_{h}=0.6T works well for most cases. When the irradiance cue is reliable, a smaller t h t_{h} helps preserve more high-frequency appearance details. When the cue is noisy or less aligned, a larger t h t_{h} is preferable because it suppresses artifacts more aggressively.

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) for 12K steps at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution using a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and batch size 16. paragraphs.en: We compare our method with the publicly available video relighting method DiffusionRenderer ( Liang et al., 2025 ) , UniRelight ( He et al., 2025 ) and Light-X ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . Image relighting methods DiLightNet ( Zeng et al., 2024b ) and Neural-Gaffer ( Jin et al., 2024 ) are also included. We adopt the Cosmos ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) implementation version of DiffusionRenderer for a fair comparison. These methods allow environment maps as control signals. We additionally include prompt-based relighting methods, including IC-Light ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , Light-A-Video ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , TC-Light ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . For environment-map-conditioned methods we use the identical target HDR map; prompt-based methods instead receive best-effort captions derived from the target lighting, so exact direction and intensity cannot be guaranteed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的方法与公开可用的视频重光照方法 DiffusionRenderer（Liang 等，2025）、UniRelight（He 等，2025）和 Light-X（Liu 等，2025a）进行比较。 图像重光照方法 DiLightNet（Zeng 等，2024b）和 Neural-Gaffer（Jin 等，2024）也被纳入比较。 为了公平比较，我们采用 DiffusionRenderer 的 Cosmos（Agarwal 等，2025）实现版本。 这些方法允许使用环境贴图作为控制信号。 我们还额外纳入了基于提示词的重光照方法，包括 IC-Light（Zhang 等，2025b）、Light-A-Video（Zhou 等，2025）和 TC-Light（Liu 等，2025b）。 对于以环境贴图为条件的方法，我们使用完全相同的目标 HDR 贴图；而基于提示词的方法则接收由目标光照生成的尽力描述文本，因此无法保证精确的方向和强度。

paragraphs.en: Figures 5 and 6 compare vertical and horizontal cases, respectively; the latter includes SynthStatic examples. Prompt-based methods including IC-Light, TC-Light, and Light-A-Video produce appealing lighting styles, but cannot precisely control lighting direction or ambient color because text prompts are ambiguous. These methods often produce warm tones and can retain hard input shadows, as in the second case of Figure 5 . Light-X and Neural Gaffer inherits much of the input lighting distribution and mainly modifies color tone, while DiLightNet produces low-quality results caused by inaccurate material estimates. DiffusionRenderer and UniRelight performs reasonably well in terms of light direction and color. However, inaccurate material estimation yields unrealistic skin and clothing textures (Figs. 6 and 5 ). It also causes identity drift, demonstrated on the third case of Figure 6 . More importantly, implicit light transport modeling sometimes fails to produce physically correct results. In Fig. 5 (third case), DiffusionRenderer mistakes yellow ambient light for the main source, ignoring the actual moon light. In contrast, our method models light transport with guidance from the path-traced irradiance cue, facilitating physically accurate illumination control. Although trained on human-centric data, our method also generalizes to the cat example in Figure 6 .

paragraphs.en: A user study evaluated perceptual quality on in-the-wild videos. paragraphs.en: We conduct ablation study on our asynchronous RGB-irradiance joint modeling and domain matching strategy with qualitative results in Figure 10 . Without the asynchronous joint modeling training paradigm, simply using the irradiance cue as control signal, the model fails to follow the light transport. Joint modeling alone does not sufficiently bridge the domain gap; domain matching is essential for producing pixel-aligned irradiance maps and physically plausible RGB results. Without it, the denoised irradiance maps exhibit black edges and blurred details, leading to suboptimal outputs. In contrast, the full recipe generates pixel-aligned RGB and irradiance images, producing physically accurate and visually plausible results.

paragraphs.en: We report quantitative ablation results in Tables 3 and 4 . We additionally train a no-irradiance variant that receives only the target HDR environment map under the same data and optimization protocol, analogous to HDR-conditioned implicit relighting. All ablation models are trained for 6K steps, with domain matching applied during the final 2K steps. HDR map conditioning does not provide pixel-aligned guidance for light distribution, which produces less accurate relighting results compared to irradiance conditioning. Joint modeling irradiance and RGB alone brings limited gains because the imperfect irradiance cue still causes a noticeable train-test mismatch. Introducing hijacked conditional generation and asynchronous timestep scheduling progressively improves both lighting fidelity and visual quality, while the domain matching strategy delivers the final performance boost by explicitly aligning the cue distribution with inference-time inputs. We also compare different modality embedding strategies and find that injecting the modality cue through the time embedding performs best, likely because it modulates the denoising process globally and reduces the ambiguity between RGB appearance and irradiance guidance.

paragraphs.en: We present JointLight, a human-centric video relighting framework that jointly models RGB and irradiance asynchronously. We also introduce a high-quality human-centric multi-illumination synthetic dataset covering indoor and outdoor scenarios, paired with ground-truth irradiance maps. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model achieves state-of-the-art relighting quality and fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 JointLight，一个以人为中心的视频重光照框架，它以异步方式联合建模 RGB 与辐照度。 我们还引入了一个涵盖室内与室外场景的高质量以人为中心的多光照合成数据集，并配有真实辐照度图。 仅在该数据集上训练，我们的模型即达到了最先进的重光照质量与保真度。

paragraphs.en: Our method depends on monocular geometry only through the rendered irradiance cue. Because geometry is estimated independently per frame, errors do not accumulate as global reconstruction drift. Noise injection suppresses high-frequency defects such as jagged boundaries, holes, and aliased shadows, but cannot recover light transport that is absent from severely incorrect geometry. Aggressive subject or camera motion can also produce blur and occlusion errors. Incorrect depths or holes near discontinuities may distort the path-traced cue and can cause light leakage (the bottom-right case in Figure 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法仅通过渲染辐照度线索依赖单目几何。 由于几何是逐帧独立估计的，误差不会以全局重建漂移的形式累积。 噪声注入可以抑制锯齿边缘、孔洞和混叠阴影等高频缺陷，但无法恢复严重错误几何中缺失的光传输。 剧烈的主体或相机运动也会产生模糊和遮挡误差。 不连续处附近错误的深度或孔洞可能会扭曲路径追踪线索，并可能导致漏光（图 9 右下角的情形）。

paragraphs.en: First, irradiance provides diffuse transport only and therefore cannot explicitly or physically control full specular transport. Video priors can synthesize plausible moderate highlights on skin and hair, but these effects are not guaranteed to follow the target illumination; polished metal, mirrors, and glass remain difficult. A failure case is shown in the bottom-right case of Figure 9 . Second, suppressing high-frequency cue errors can also attenuate texture-rich appearance, occasionally over-smoothing fine facial details around the eyes and mouth. Future work could jointly reason about geometry, material, diffuse and specular transport, and use detail-preserving or preference-based post-training. Extending the control representation beyond environment maps to local spotlights or flashlights is another promising direction.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，辐照度仅提供漫反射传输，因此无法以显式或物理的方式控制完整的高光传输。 视频先验可以在皮肤和头发上合成合理的中等强度高光，但这些效果并不能保证遵循目标光照；抛光金属、镜子和玻璃仍然难以处理。 图9右下角的案例展示了一个失败案例。 其次，抑制高频线索误差也会削弱纹理丰富的外观，偶尔会过度平滑眼睛和嘴巴周围的精细面部细节。 未来的工作可以对几何、材质、漫反射和高光传输进行联合推理，并采用保留细节的或基于偏好的后训练方法。 将控制表示从环境贴图扩展到局部聚光灯或闪光灯是另一个有前景的方向。
